newsitem.title: UK: Libya raises most August term crudes by 10 cts.
newsitem.headline: Libya raises most August term crudes by 10 cts.

text.p: Libya's National Oil Company (NOC) raised most term crude contract price formulae for August liftings by 10 cents, traders said.
Es Sider for August will be priced 10 cents up from July at Dated Brent -20 cents.
But Brega was raised by just five cents to Dated Brent +30 cents and Zuetina was left unchanged from July at Dated Brent +15 cents.

Sirtica was raised by 10 cents to Dated Brent -5 cents, and Amna and Sarir were increased by the same amount to Dated Brent -55 cents and -50 cents respectively. Bu Attifel was lifted by five cents to Dated Brent -30 cents.
Offshore Bouri was left unchanged for the third month running at Iranian Heavy -35 cents fob Sidi Kreir.
